set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2] vlan-id [parameter3].explanation: Configure the VLAN ID of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID to identify different virtual local area networks.

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set protocols bgp group [parameter1].explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

type [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of BGP group to be external.

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of BGP group, e.g. external.

peer-as [parameter2].explanation: Configure the BGP group's equivalent AS.

parameters.name: peer-as
parameters.explanation: Reciprocal AS, which is used to identify the autonomous system in which BGP equivalents are located.

neighbor [parameter2] family inet unicas.explanation: The address of the BGP neighbour is distributed to the IPv4 live.

export [parameter2].explanation: Configure the BGP group to export the direct route.

parameters.name: export-policy
parameters.explanation: Exportes the policy name to control the export of the BGP route.

set policy-options policy-statement [par.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

term [parameter2] from protocol [paramet.explanation: Configures the matching condition for a policy statement as a direct route.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.explanation: Matches the type of protocol, such as direct.

term [parameter2] then [parameter3].explanation: Configure the action condition for the policy statement to be accepted.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.
